titulo: Never Kill a House Centipede. Here's Why
titulos_alternativos: The Scariest Bug in Your House Is on Your Side
Why You Should Never Kill a House Centipede
descripcion:
It has thirty legs, it runs up walls, and it might be the scariest looking thing living in your house. It is also the best roommate you will ever have.

In this video: where the house centipede came from, how it grows its legs, how fast it really is, how it hunts, what it eats inside your home, whether it can hurt you, why it shows up in your bathroom, and what to do if you don't want it around.
